p1.note: Distil a paired-rollout buy teacher into a Deep Sets student on top of RL-v3 c2.

stages.name: 1 Labels
stages.world: c2 plays every buy; the teacher grades it with paired rollouts to the end
stages.pass: pilot (in code): capped and rejected rollouts < 1%, the test suite (reproducible + replayable labels) passes

stages.name: 2 Student fit
stages.world: fit the Deep Sets student on all labels; dev match student-on-c2 vs c2
stages.pass: dev score >= 50.5% at the best margin, confirmed on an independent dev stream

stages.name: 3 DAgger
stages.world: the student plays its buys, the teacher grades them (positions the student reaches)

stages.name: 4 Promotion
stages.world: 2,000 fresh confirmation kingdoms, both seats, vs c1 2300, c2 2654 and the GA base
stages.pass: >= 53% vs both RL-v3, kingdom-block 95% interval above 50%, GA base no more than 1 point below plain c2's
